title: Break-Even Analysis
author: 3iGR44tcGMnRnhEYm
chapter_outcomes: Explain the meaning of production, distinguish between production and productivity, analyse the benefits of increasing efficiency and methods of improving it, explain why businesses hold inventories, and evaluate the concept and benefits of lean production, including just-in-time and Kaizen.
Explain the features, benefits and limitations of job, batch and flow production and recommend and justify an appropriate production method in given circumstances.
Explain how technological change has influenced and continues to influence production methods, including the use of computers in design and manufacturing.
Identify and classify costs, including fixed, variable, total and average costs, and use cost data to support simple cost-based business decisions.

Explain the concepts of economies and diseconomies of scale and analyse examples of each, including purchasing, marketing, financial, managerial and technical economies, and communication and coordination problems.

Explain and apply break-even analysis by constructing and interpreting break-even charts, calculating break-even output and margin of safety, using the analysis to support simple decisions, and evaluating its limitations.
Explain why quality is important to businesses and evaluate how quality can be achieved through quality control and quality assurance.

Analyse the main factors influencing business location and relocation decisions, including manufacturing and service businesses, country choice and legal controls, and recommend and justify an appropriate business location in given circumstances.
